sources.name: Apex Park and Recreation District – Camps (Arvada/west Westminster)
sources.reason: Official page for Apex PRD youth camps. It has registration dates (last cycle: returning families from Jan 19, 8 am, then new families), payment plans and camp sites. The summer 2027 registration notice should appear here around January.

sources.name: Apex Park and Recreation District
sources.reason: District home page for preschool, youth and teen programs, classes and sports in Arvada and the Westminster area. It links to upcoming activities and registration.

sources.name: Apex PRD online registration (ActiveNet)
sources.reason: Live registration portal where you can search current and upcoming Apex classes, camps and youth sports sessions.

sources.name: City of Northglenn – Activity Guide
sources.reason: Official seasonal activity guides with youth and teen classes, camps and sports. The fall 2026 guide covers Aug–Dec, and the next guide (winter/spring) should be posted here.

sources.name: City of Northglenn – Grades 6–8 Youth & Teen Programs
sources.reason: Middle-school programs with single-day/drop-in and full-week registration, plus the 2026 parent packet.

sources.name: City of Northglenn – Roving Recreation (ages 12–17)
sources.reason: Teen outing program with trips to pools, amusement centers and adventure activities. Good for school-break plans.

sources.name: City of Northglenn – School Age Day Camp
sources.reason: Day camp at Northglenn Recreation Center with swimming, field trips and park outings. Watch here for school-break and summer 2027 sign-ups.

sources.name: Denver Zoo Conservation Alliance – Safari Camps
sources.reason: Official zoo camp page for summer camps (K–9th grade, run weekly) and winter-break Safari Camps. Registration goes through your own zoo account.

sources.name: Wings Over the Rockies – Air & Space Summer Camps
sources.reason: Week-long aerospace camps (drones, Mars and space themes) at the Lowry and Centennial sites. The page says next summer's camps are announced in winter.

sources.name: Wings Over the Rockies – Education
sources.reason: Hub for youth aviation programs, including Young Eagles, flight-training scholarships, simulators, school programs and Little Wings events for young kids.

sources.name: Denver Zoo Conservation Alliance – Things To Do
sources.reason: The zoo's official events page with dates. It lists seasonal events like Fall at DZCA (through 2026-10-31), Zoo Lights, Boo at the Zoo and the spring Glowing Wild lantern nights.

sources.name: Visit Denver – Mile High Holidays: Holiday Lights Events
sources.reason: Official Denver tourism page that collects holiday light events across the metro, including Zoo Lights, with costs and dates. Good for planning outings in November and December.

sources.name: Front Range Community College – Continuing Education (noncredit)
sources.reason: FRCC's Westminster campus is the closest community college. This catalog lists noncredit courses, workshops, certifications and personal-enrichment classes, with sign-up dates for each term.

sources.name: City of Westminster – Adult Athletics
sources.reason: Main page for Westminster's adult sports leagues and sign-ups: basketball, indoor soccer, pickleball, softball and volleyball.

sources.name: Westminster Sports Center – Adult Indoor Soccer
sources.reason: Indoor soccer leagues that run all year at the Westminster Sports Center, with details on how to register for each season.

sources.name: Westminster – Adult Volleyball
sources.reason: Adult volleyball leagues at City Park Recreation Center and the Westminster Sports Center. A good way to make friends.

sources.name: Westminster – Adult Basketball
sources.reason: Season sign-ups for the men's basketball leagues.

sources.name: Westminster – Adult Softball
sources.reason: Spring softball league. The page lists 2026 dates (captains' meeting in March, games starting the week of March 23). It's worth checking for the 2027 spring dates.

sources.name: Arvada Center – Classes for Adults
sources.reason: Adult classes in ceramics, dance, painting and other arts, open for registration each term, at a big arts center near Westminster.

sources.name: Arvada Center – Ceramics Studio
sources.reason: Ceramics classes from beginner to advanced wheel-throwing and handbuilding. There are also classes for teens and kids and parent/child classes.

sources.name: Arvada Center – Dance Classes
sources.reason: Tap, ballet, jazz and general dance classes for every skill level, including adults.

sources.name: Adams 12 Five Star Schools – District Calendar
sources.reason: The official district calendar. It lists no-school days, academic dates, Board of Education meetings and community events such as parent sessions, and links the 2026-27 year-at-a-glance PDF.

sources.name: Adams 12 Five Star Schools Calendar (Tandem)
sources.reason: A searchable 2026-2027 calendar for Adams 12 with holidays and team schedules. It is useful for planning around school breaks.

sources.name: Adams 12 School Year BASE (Before & After School Care)
sources.reason: The district's before- and after-school care program, with how many spots are open at each site for the 2026-27 school year. Useful for registration.

events.title: Denver Zoo Winter Safari Camps (winter break) – registration
